package parsers

import (
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

func TestParseCourseFiltersRequiresCompleteCatalogSlugPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		query   string
		wantErr bool
	}{
		{name: "no scope", query: "", wantErr: false},
		{name: "complete scope", query: "track_slug=foundation&level_slug=beginner", wantErr: false},
		{name: "track only", query: "track_slug=foundation", wantErr: true},
		{name: "level only", query: "level_slug=beginner", wantErr: true},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/catalog/course/list?"+tt.query, nil)
			filter, err := ParseCourseFilters(req, validator.New())
			if (err != nil) != tt.wantErr {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.wantErr)
			}
			if !tt.wantErr && tt.query != "" {
				if filter.TrackSlug == nil || *filter.TrackSlug != "foundation" {
					t.Fatalf("track slug = %#v", filter.TrackSlug)
				}
				if filter.LevelSlug == nil || *filter.LevelSlug != "beginner" {
					t.Fatalf("level slug = %#v", filter.LevelSlug)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
